su_sd_note: schools.csv lists 'Franklin Northwest Supervisory Union' (FNWSU). The district now presents itself as 'Missisquoi Valley School District' (site title, 'MVSD Board Meeting', superintendent Julie Regimbal), a single-district supervisory district: Census BAS25 lists 'Missisquoi Valley School District (Supervisory)' and an AOE report title cites 'SU021 Missisquoi Valley School District (Supervisory)' (SU021 was FNWSU's number). Remnants of the old name remain (fnwsu.org Google Sites for student services/employee portal). Effectively FNWSU reorganized/renamed into MVSD; recorded as false per the rename rule, human check suggested.
